a.lede: Some hosts are threatening to strike, while others are plotting ways around Airbnb’s new restrictions. Guests, meanwhile, are celebrating.
a.title: Airbnb Hosts Are Furious They Can No Longer Make Guests Do Their Chores

b.lede: Any chores that a cleaner might do are no longer deemed reasonable requests for visitors.
b.title: Airbnb bans hosts from making you do the dishes
